name: 屏幕拍摄
author: Ava
description: Capture this device screen into Home Assistant. One button, one camera frame.
detail_description: Take a screenshot of whatever is on the Ava device right now and expose it as a Home Assistant camera. Uses Shizuku/root screencap when available, otherwise Ava accessibility on Android 11+. Optional timestamp sensor for automations that need to know when the frame was last refreshed.

config.label: 上次截取时间
config.description: 在 Home Assistant 中暴露上次截取屏幕的时间戳，方便自动化判断画面是否最新
